prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "lila". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "purple".
Scene: An adult wearing an unmistakably purple sweater against a neutral cream background, color saturated and central.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "lila = purple.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon har en lila tröja.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
